rho_reference.binary_or_process: N4 v2 driver. The IC arm is CAND (research/ic_gw_nrm_lz_20261115/src, sha256 a7e4ad7a41e5..., run with NRM=1 LZ_REUSE=1); without the variables it equals BLR1 (e236855d7fef...) in every counted field, and with them it differs only in relations.mul/add (and D/DL1 linear_algebra.lmul/ladd); its REF arm reproduces the BLR1 band values exactly (validator VAL-20261115-5c7af8, rel. error 0). The rho reference is v3's rho2::rho_neg, which replays the frozen k = 22 negation-map run field for field (research/quartic_dl1_cd_sqrt_20261113/combo/validation/rho-replay-v3-k22-neg-seed2-run1.jsonl, 0 differences)
rho_reference.strongest_available_note: E0 has coefficients generic in K = F_{q^3} (built from u, u^q, u^{q^2}), so no Frobenius endomorphism; the negation map is the available symmetry. Plain rho at k = 22 for comparison: IC/rho 0.0024, 0.0026, 0.0032 at w = 0, 0.1, 1.
